title: Unveiling the enhanced structural, elastic, mechanical, and optoelectronic properties of BaWO4 via oxygen vacancies and europium doping: a DFT + U insight into tailored energy applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18681-18696
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01743B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shah Hussain, Raj Wali, Sikander Azam, Qaiser Rafiq, Mehmoona Nisar, Wilayat Khan, Yasir Saeed, Mohammed A. Amin
Eu doping and oxygen vacancies in BaWO4 reduce the band gap and enhance optoelectronic properties. DFT + U calculations show improved absorption and dielectric response, making it a promising material for energy-efficient optical devices.
